name: JSON to CSV Converter
description: Convert a JSON array of objects to CSV instantly, with a header row built from every object's keys and correct quoting of commas, quotes, and newlines.

faq.question: What if my objects have different keys from each other?
faq.answer: The header row is the union of every object's keys, so an object missing a field some others have simply gets an empty cell in that column, rather than the field being silently dropped from the output.

faq.question: What happens with nested objects or arrays as values?
faq.answer: They're converted to a plain string with JavaScript's default stringification (a nested object becomes the not-very-useful "[object Object]"; an array becomes its values joined with commas) rather than automatically flattened into extra columns — flatten nested data into separate top-level fields before converting if you need each nested value in its own column.
